description: A composite figure group: two SEM micrographs each paired with an SEM-EDS line-scan composition profile, one pair per annealing condition. Panel (a) is a SEM micrograph of the specimen annealed at 800 °C, 1 h (printed top-right), scale bar 10 µm, with red α, blue γ and yellow κ labels, yellow arrows pointing at elongated κ-carbide particles, and a white horizontal arrow spanning the image as the EDS line-scan path; the underlying line scan plots Composition (wt,%) against Position (µm) from 0 to ~45 µm with a broken y-axis (segment 20-50 wt.% omitted) and legend Al K (solid red), Mn K (dashed blue), Fe K (dotted black); phase labels κ, α, κ, α, κ, α, κ, γ are printed below the x-axis. Fe K stays near the 80 wt.% gridline but dips to ~70 wt.% at every κ position, where Al K and Mn K rise together. Panel (b) is the 900 °C, 1 h SEM micrograph (same 10 µm scale bar) labelling α, α and γ with no κ annotation, showing equiaxed grains with bright boundaries; its line scan shows Fe K near the 80 wt.% gridline while Mn K maxima (between the 10 and 20 wt.% gridlines) occur in γ-labelled intervals where Al K is lowest. The pair therefore demonstrates κ-carbide enrichment in Mn and Al with Fe depletion, and different Mn/Al partitioning between phases at 800 and 900 °C.

subfigures.description: Secondary/back-scattered SEM image annotated '800 °C, 1 h' with a 10 µm scale bar; red 'α' marks a featureless region at left, blue 'γ' a region at upper right, and yellow 'κ' with arrows marks elongated/lamellar particles in the middle band; a white horizontal double-headed arrow across the image marks the EDS line-scan path.

Composition (wt,%) vs Position (µm, 0-45 µm) with a broken y-axis (20-50 wt.% omitted). Legend: Al K solid red, Mn K dashed blue, Fe K dotted black. Fe K ~80 wt.% with dips toward the 70 wt.% gridline at κ positions, where Al K (~11 wt.%) and Mn K (~10-14 wt.%) show coincident maxima. Phase labels under the axis read κ, α, κ, α, κ, α, κ, γ.

SEM image annotated '900 °C, 1 h' with a 10 µm scale bar; red 'α' labels a featureless region at left and a grain region at centre-right, blue 'γ' a region at right; no κ label is present. Grains are equiaxed with bright (κ-carbide-like) boundaries; a white horizontal arrow marks the EDS line-scan path.

Composition (wt,%) vs Position (µm, 0-45 µm), same broken y-axis and same Al K / Mn K / Fe K legend. Fe K fluctuates around the 80 wt.% gridline; Mn K peaks between the 10 and 20 wt.% gridlines in γ-labelled intervals, where Al K is at its lowest (~10 wt.%). Phase labels under the axis alternate α and γ ending with γ.

observations.observation: The group contains four images of two kinds: two SEM micrographs and two SEM-EDS line-scan composition profiles, one micrograph-profile pair per annealing temperature.
Micrograph (a) is annotated '800 °C, 1 h' and micrograph (b) '900 °C, 1 h'; both carry a 10 µm scale bar and a white horizontal double-headed arrow indicating the EDS line-scan path.

Micrograph (a) labels three phases: red 'α' (featureless region at left), blue 'γ' (right) and yellow 'κ' with arrows pointing to elongated particles; micrograph (b) labels only red 'α' (twice) and blue 'γ', with no κ annotation.
Both line-scan plots use x-axis 'Position (µm)' from 0 to about 45 µm and y-axis 'Composition (wt,%)' with a broken scale in which the 20-50 wt.% segment is omitted.
The line-scan legend is identical in both profiles: Al K (solid red line), Mn K (dashed blue line) and Fe K (dotted black line).
In the 800 °C profile, Fe K lies near the 80 wt.% gridline but drops to about the 70 wt.% gridline at each κ-labelled position, exactly where both Al K and Mn K show local maxima.
Phase labels printed beneath the 800 °C profile read, from left to right, κ, α, κ, α, κ, α, κ, γ, i.e. κ is present in several intervals along the scan.
In the 900 °C profile the phase labels beneath the x-axis alternate α and γ and end with γ; no κ interval is labelled, and Mn K maxima coincide with the γ intervals while Al K is lowest there.
In the 900 °C profile Fe K fluctuates around the 80 wt.% gridline without the pronounced dips seen at κ positions in the 800 °C profile.
The caption states that Fig. 13 presents SEM EDS line scanning results of specimens annealed at (a) 800 °C and (b) 900 °C.
The citing text states that in the specimen annealed at 800 °C, Mn content is higher and Al content is lower in α phase than in γ phase, while both Mn and Al contents are highest in κ-carbide.

A second citing sentence states the opposite partition for Mn — 'Compared with in α phase, Mn content is higher, while Al content is lower in the γ phase (Fig. 13)' — which conflicts with the earlier sentence; the two statements cannot both describe the same phase pair.
The citing text attributes the observed partitioning to competition for Mn and C between neighbouring α phase and κ-carbide and for Al between neighbouring γ phase and κ-carbide.
The citing text states that the dissolution temperature of κ-carbide lies between 850 °C and 900 °C, and that κ-carbide along α/α boundaries dissolves last.

measured_quantities: Al K, Mn K and Fe K concentration profiles (wt,%)
unreadable_items: Both line-scan plots use a broken y-axis; the 20-50 wt.% segment is omitted, so any data in that range are not displayed.
Exact wt.% values of the Al K and Mn K maxima are not printed as labels and can only be read relative to the 10 and 20 wt.% gridlines.
The small phase labels printed directly beneath the x-axes are low contrast against the axis lettering and are only partly legible at the supplied resolution.
